Remark
[Huygens' principle] ↗ thm:wave-equation-odd-dimensions-solution ↗ thm:wave-equation-even-dimensions-solution 1. ch2:2.4.1-rem-3\group Wave Equation

For odd $n\ge 3$, data at $x$ affect the solution only on the boundary $|y-x|=t$ of the forward cone. For even $n$, formula (38) uses the entire ball $B(y,t)$, so the data continue to influence the cone interior after the leading front passes.
